name: CrawlRaven SEO
description: CrawlRaven gives Claude read-only access to your authorized SEO workspace. It can analyze Google Search Console performance, compare clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position, inspect top queries and ranking pages, review prioritized SEO opportunities, and retrieve target keywords and timeline annotations. Access is limited to the CrawlRaven account selected during authorization. The connector never modifies your website or Google Search Console data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CrawlRaven SEO to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CrawlRaven SEO to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.crawlraven.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CrawlRaven SEO MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CrawlRaven SEO provides these MCP tools: get_search_performance, get_website_overview, list_annotations, list_opportunities, list_pages, list_queries, list_target_keywords, and list_websites.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CrawlRaven SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CrawlRaven SEO in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does CrawlRaven SEO MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: CrawlRaven SEO requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CrawlRaven SEO is developed by CrawlRaven. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
